title: Extrema with Fractional Exponent and Undefined Derivative
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the absolute extrema of f(x) = x^(2/3) * (5 - 2x) on [-1, 2].
finalAnswer: \text{Absolute Maximum: } 7 \text{ at } x = -1; \quad \text{Absolute Minimum: } 0 \text{ at } x = 0

steps.title: Identify Critical Points
steps.mathExpression: f'(x) = 0 \implies 1 - x = 0 \implies x = 1; \quad f'(x) \text{ undefined at } x = 0
steps.explanation: x = 1 makes numerator zero; x = 0 makes denominator zero.
steps.why: Both x = 1 and x = 0 are critical points in (-1, 2).

steps.title: Evaluate f at All Candidates
steps.explanation: Evaluate f at endpoints and critical points. The maximum value is 7 at x = -1, and minimum is 0 at x = 0.
steps.why: Extreme value theorem guarantees maximum and minimum occur at critical points or endpoints.
